proposed_widenings.name: ActivatedAbilityMechanics.range
proposed_widenings.justification: Non-spell activation units can already target areas via point_within_range, but the family has no authored range field, so ranged item activations collapse to an incorrect self-range trace.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can take a Magic action to detach a bead and throw it up to 60 feet away."

notes: An attempted encoding typechecked and traced, but the tracer rendered the explosion as `origin: point within Self` because ordinary activation mechanics do not carry a range. The content files were removed rather than keep a misleading trace.
